project.name: ResumePilotAI
project.title: Universal Enterprise AI Career Platform & Multi-Portal Ecosystem
project.summary: Full-stack production platform featuring 4 enterprise portals, 68 front-end application routes, 51-template resume studio, high-fidelity DOCX/PDF export pipelines, real-time AI audio interview simulator, dual-database synchronized persistence, an autonomous multi-provider LLM routing engine, a fully specified Cuba design system, and an executable build task graph enabling autonomous end-to-end delivery.

frontend.stylingApproach: Vanilla CSS Design Tokens + Scoped Component SCSS (Strict Zero-Tailwind Policy in Cuba surfaces)
frontend.designSystem: Cuba Executive Glassmorphism & Google Material 3 Token Architecture

securityMiddleware: Express Rate Limiters (Global, Auth Burst, AI Quotas, Export Limiter, Webhook Limiter)

webServer.proxyConfiguration: Reverse proxy /api/ requests to Node.js backend (:8080)
webServer.sslRenewal: Documented self-signed rotation + certbot-ready for production

database.architecture: Dual-Database Platform with Autonomous Intelligent Sync

primaryRelational.authority: ACID System of Record (Enterprise, Billing, Portals, Credentials, Core Records)
primaryRelational.migrationPolicy: forward-only with tested rollback scripts and pre-migration snapshot

secondaryDocument.authority: Live State Synchronization, Real-time Feeds, Resilient Node
invariants: Zero hard-dependency on Firestore for authentication or billing
Durable SQLite/MariaDB outbox queue captures mutations for guaranteed replay
Plaintext credentials and API keys strictly prohibited in Firestore payloads
Firestore is always reconstructible from MariaDB canonical documents

safetyGuards: extractJson normalization helper mandatory for all LLM parsing
Zero synthetic fallback: real provider errors propagated with actionable diagnostics
All third-party API keys stored exclusively on server side with zero client DOM exposure

environmentAndSecrets.secretPolicy: server-side only; never expose AI/provider/payment keys to Vite client

securityInvariants: Strict multi-tenant SQL parameter isolation (`tenant_id` guard)
Zero cross-tenant data leakage across all queries and API responses
Durable outbox retry for asynchronous enterprise events

resumeStudioAndTemplates.lockPolicy: STRICT 0-BYTE DIFF LOCK: Antigravity and automated tools must never modify the 51 certified templates without explicit human authorization.

capabilities: Adaptive content partitioner preventing orphaned headers or split bullets
Native Word paragraph styles, bullet indents, table borders, and font mapping
Photo toggle support for recruiter-friendly ATS formatting
Browser native @media print output via hidden isolated iframe
A4 and US Letter page sizing with zero overflow clipping

thumbnailGenerator.format: Optimized WebP / PNG previews for all 51 templates

executiveBioGenerator.behavior: Evidence-grounded synthesis using prior work history, education, and achievements. Zero generic cliches.

audioInterviewCoach.behavior: Real-time speech CBT simulator. Dynamic question generation, confidence scoring, radar chart evaluation.

coverLetterSynthesizer.behavior: Target company alignment, job posting requirements cross-referencing, professional/charismatic tone calibration.

atsScoreEngine.behavior: Keyword density verification, action verb analysis, contact info validation, layout parsability rating.

smartBulletGenerator.behavior: XYZ formula enforcement (Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]). Quantitative metric insertion.

example.empty: CubaEmptyState 'No jobs match your filters. Clear filters or widen location.'

interactionSpec.reducedMotion: honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; disable non-essential motion
interactionSpec.focusPolicy: focus-visible ring required on every interactive element
interactionSpec.hoverPolicy: no state change that cannot also be triggered by keyboard

formSpec.validationTiming: onBlur + onSubmit; onInput after first error
formSpec.submitPolicy: disable on submit, re-enable on response, prevent double-submit

navigationIA.modalVsPage: modal for ≤ 2 fields and reversible; page for multi-step or deep-linkable
navigationIA.deepLinkRules: every filter, tab, and modal state must be URL-addressable
navigationIA.backStack: browser back never loses unsaved form data; prompt if dirty

dataViz.a11y: aria-label + data table fallback per chart

uxAcceptanceCriteria: Every error message names a next action

dataGovernanceAndSchema.migrationPolicy: forward-only, tested rollback, no destructive migration without backup
dataGovernanceAndSchema.foreignKeyPolicy: ON DELETE RESTRICT for financial/audit, ON DELETE CASCADE for child-only data

rbac.enforcement: backend middleware + tenant_id guard + row-level checks

auth.refreshToken: httpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict rotating 30d with family revocation
auth.passwordPolicy: min 12 chars, breach check via HIBP k-anonymity

webSecurity: rate limits (global, auth, ai, export, webhook)
file upload MIME magic + AV scan

deliveryAndOperations.deployment: Apache static + Node systemd/PM2 behind reverse proxy; blue-green when possible
deliveryAndOperations.rollback: previous release + DB migration rollback/forward fix

aiGovernance.routingPolicy: provider priority, health, cost ceiling, latency, tenant policy
costControls: provider fallback only if cost <= ceiling

accessibility.landmarks: Unique aria-label on all nav and main landmark regions
